purpose: Transactional service for authenticated checkout draft creation, final customer order placement, and customer-owned order status reads.
businessRules: Never trust browser-submitted prices, totals, product names, SKUs, or media.
Proceed-to-checkout creates or reuses an ACTIVE 15-minute customer_order_drafts row for the authenticated customer and exact normalized cart signature.
Before creating a new draft, expired ACTIVE drafts are marked EXPIRED and changed-cart ACTIVE drafts are marked INVALIDATED.
Final order placement requires draftOrderId and validates that the draft is ACTIVE, unexpired, customer-owned, and has the same cart signature as the submitted lines.
A successfully placed order marks the checkout draft CONVERTED in the same transaction as customer_orders/customer_order_items/status events.
Load active product-card records from backend storefront tables and snapshot SKU, slug, family, type, media, unit price, and line price into order items.
Merge duplicate product lines and cap line quantity before persistence.
Write initial ORDER_STATUS, PAYMENT_STATUS, and FULFILLMENT_STATUS events in the same transaction as the order.
Return order status only for the authenticated customer owner.
List profile order summaries by customer_orders.customer_id so every order history row is owned by the authenticated customerId, independent of whether the customer logged in by email or phone.
